scenes: Here's every kind of promise, in his own words.
March first. "We intended four to five weeks."
March seventeenth. "We'll be leaving in pretty much the very near future."
April sixteenth. "It should be ending pretty soon."
June eleventh. "Over the next few days."
September ninth. "This war will end immediately after our election."
October ninth. "One way or another, it's gonna be over soon."
October thirtieth. "It's going to get wrapped up soon."
November first. "We'll put it away very soon."
And that same night: "It's going to be over very soon. Very soon."
Thirty-four times. Here's what happened in between.
